name: Family Trouble
source:
"Family Trouble" is an erotic comedy novel game with sharp humor. You play as an education professor at a university. One day, your best friend's stepdaughter offers to share the house with you after getting a place at the university where you teach. This triggers a series of random events and humorous situations in your character's life, ultimately leading to a supernatural conspiracy where you'll need to step up as a hero for the entire family." 

[From [url=https://rebootlove.itch.io/genex-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“《家破人亡》是一款幽默犀利的情色喜剧小说游戏。你扮演一所大学的教育学教授。有一天，你最好朋友的继女在你任教的大学获得一席之地后提出与你合住房子。这会在你的角色的生活中引发一系列随机事件和幽默情境，最终导致一个超自然的阴谋，你需要挺身而出，成为整个家庭的英雄。” 

[来自[url=https://rebootlove.itch.io/genex-love]Itch.io[/url]]
